mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over three months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending power, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by >0.5pp over 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal housing sector contraction that reduces household wealth and consumer confidence, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below its 6-month moving average signals manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate earnings visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 6-month MA, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust household demand that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above 12-month MA, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point year-over-year increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% signals accelerating inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY and rising >0.5pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises above 3.5% YoY by >0.5pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and confidence, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and UNRATE decline, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO below 100) combined with declining industrial production signals supply chain disruptions that dampen corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3 years.
